result.summary: The screen is generally functional, but exhibits minor visual inconsistencies in thumbnail styling and notification badge positioning.

issues.description: Inconsistent image styling across restaurant cards, mixing flat white-background graphics with dark, textured backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image style and background treatments across all restaurant thumbnails.

issues.description: The notification indicator dot overlaps the center of the bell icon rather than aligning to the top-right corner.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the badge dot to the upper-right corner of the notification bell.
